description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git am --abort' functionality within Git. It contains various test cases that simulate applying patches, handling conflicts, aborting operations, and verifying that the repository state correctly reverts to the initial state after abort commands.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file, used to prepare test data.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, helping simulate passage of time between commits.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a particular command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given file or directory does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs a testing utility command with arguments, such as changing file modification time.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup command to run after tests complete.
